notes: Multi Studio version 2.2.4: **Persistent Export Settings in Script Studio**: Your export preferences (such as ZIP packaging, individual audio clips, combined track, and subtitle format) are now automatically saved and remembered when you close and reopen the app., **Smooth Audio Seeking & Scrubbing**: Fixed an issue where dragging or clicking the seek bar on individual audio cards would unexpectedly pause playback. You can now scrub smoothly through audio segments without interruptions., **Audio Playback & Pause Button Synchronization**: Resolved an issue where audio could occasionally continue playing in the background even after clicking the pause button. Pausing now immediately and reliably silences all playback.
